papers.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retai
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26860，published 2026-10-19）：OpenVLHarness 先用受控实验否掉了 'simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains' 这条最省事的路（对照覆盖 22 个 benchmark）；然后把收益做在 harness 结构上——作者自述其 'organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory'。capability layer 的原文是 'The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations'；persistent memory 'retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query'；coding interface 'executes generated programs over stored data'，从而 'support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence'。证据是 22 个 benchmark × 8 个开源与闭源 backbone 的 matched no-tool 对照：'improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines'（Qwen3-VL-8B +11.2、Kimi K3 +9.7、GPT-6 Astra +9.9）；成本侧给了硬数字——'outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost'。价值路由：这是今日唯一一篇 harness 结构本身可以直接照着搭的论文，属 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × context-engineering × llm-evaluation 的即时资产。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：摘要未给出，暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无），需打开 PDF 确认 harness 与工具适配协议是否开源。今日动作：按 capability layer / persistent memory / coding interface 三层写 visual-tool-harness checklist。

papers.title: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
papers.abstract: Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. As a trajectory unfolds, different stages may require different capabilities, yet conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution. We introduce WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions), which trains independent capab
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26847）：WeAct 把 '选哪个能力' 直接做成 agent 的一个动作——'trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space'，并明确 'These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context'。它针对的是长程 agent 的老毛病：'Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting'，而 'conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution'。证据是八个 deep-research benchmark：Qwen3-32B 上比 full fine-tuning 对手提升 '6.2% relative' 且 'using less compute'，比最强静态 LoRA 合并提升 '27.5% relative'；并支持 'modular continual adaptation'——新增 code computation adapter 不动 backbone 与其他 adapter。工程含义很直接：能力路由走的是模型原生 function-calling 通道，不需要额外 head、不需要改 serving 协议，是今日最容易落地的 '能力组合' 实现路径。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：摘要未给出，暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）。今日动作：评估给现有 agent 增加一个 '_switch_capability' 类工具的可行性。

papers.title: Train An Imaginative Agent
papers.abstract: A seemingly reasonable push in Sokoban can make the puzzle unsolvable. To avoid such mistakes, an agent has to anticipate the consequences of its actions before execution, especially when feedback from the real environment is sparse or actions are irreversible. We introduce Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that trains an agent to imagine before acting, i.e. to be imaginative. Agima trains a single omni model to propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26845）：Agima（Agentic Imagination）训练单个 omni 模型 'propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment'，先 SFT 统一 policy 与 world model，再用 agentic RL 教它用这些想象中的未来做规划。最强的一条数字：'Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%'——在真环境反馈稀疏且动作不可逆时，'先想象再执行' 的收益是 20 倍量级。行为层面的证据比分数更有价值：'it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points'，即 'learn when and where to look ahead'。代码与项目页今日已实测可达：项目页 https://agima.net/ （HTTP 200），仓库 https://github.com/Agentic-Imagination/Agima 。属 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 的即时资产，但迁移风险必须写清：证据全部来自 Maze2D / Sokoban / Pacman / PushT 四个玩具环境，'generalizes to harder settings unseen during training' 尚未在真实工具链上验证。今日动作：先读仓库确认 omni 模型的训练成本量级。

papers.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
papers.abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this re
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26844）：AnyGoal 盯住世界模型的一个具体失效面——'For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts'，并用 compositional generalization 作为切入口：'can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics?'。benchmark 设计克制：每个任务 'within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics'，只是 'their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories'。结论是负面且重要的一类：'current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations'。这直接约束我们自己的 world-model / planner 选型——训练分布内跑得好不等于换个目标还能用。摘要提到 'together with an open-source library'，但未给出 URL，暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）。今日动作：给内部 world-model 评测加一组 goal-shift 变体，而不是只测训练分布内任务。

papers.title: LatComm: Reusable Context Compression for Latent Communication between Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Systems that combine several large language models (LLMs) often use one context for many questions. When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question. Avoiding this cost requires a context representation that is compact, reusable across questions, and readable by a different LLM. Existing compression and latent communication methods each provide only some of these properties. We introduce LatComm, a Latent Communication in
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26840）：LatComm 解决的问题很具体——'When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question'。方法核心是把编码与读取拆开：'separating encoding from reading: the context is encoded once without the question, and the receiver selects what to read for each question'；冻结的 context encoder 压成 fixed-size packet，冻结的 receiver 通过 cross-attention 读取，且 'with gates computed from its prompt'。数字：'LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points'（12 个 MCQ 数据集平均）；在 QuALITY 上 'it reduces the receiver's input by 57x and answers the questions of an article 3x faster'。价值路由：这是今日唯一一篇直接命中多模型串联系统里重复烧 token 这张真实账单的论文，属 context-engineering × inference-serving 的趋势资产。边界必须写清：latent communication 要求两端模型冻结且可挂 cross-attention，实际接入要改 receiver 架构，摘要提到的 'readable by a different LLM' 的泛化范围论文未给出。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）。今日动作：记录为 context-engineering 趋势候选，触发条件是出现可即插即用的实现。

papers.title: Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms
papers.abstract: While LLM agents can generate visually plausible CAD assemblies, these designs often fail to fulfill their intended physical functions. We study functional CAD design, a setting where agents interpret underspecified requests to construct and iteratively revise mechanisms that satisfy functional requirements in physical simulation. Verifying these requirements is nontrivial: different candidate mechanisms may realize the same function through entirely different components, controls, and operating
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26861）：FunCAD 处理的是 agent 的 '看起来对但物理上不工作' 问题——'these designs often fail to fulfill their intended physical functions'。核心难点在验证而非生成：'different candidate mechanisms may realize the same function through entirely different components, controls, and operating sequences'，所以不能简单判 '功能是否达成'。FunCAD-Harness 的做法是 'translates abstract requirements into candidate-specific physical tests and uses simulation feedback to guide design revisions'；benchmark FunCADBench 覆盖 '46 mechanism families with interdependent and multi-step operations'。可迁移的启发不在 CAD，而在 '把抽象需求编译成候选相关的验证用例'——这对任何 '生成结果不可直接断言、但可被仿真或物理间接验证' 的 agent 场景都成立。证据为 'Experiments across frontier LLM agents' 上相对 standard simulation-augmented baselines 的成功率提升，摘要未给出具体数值与 baseline 列表。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）。今日动作：存为长尾，触发条件是出现开源实现或被多模态 agent 综述引用。

papers.title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
papers.abstract: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may cons
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26848）：这篇的稀缺之处是它质疑了 '物理自我改进' 这个概念本身的可测性。评测用五轴指标——'First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure'——跑 '18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget'。最有诊断价值的是它指出公开 benchmark 均分接近的系统可被区分，且 'high scores need not come with early or efficient gains'，即总分掩盖了学习曲线的差异。工作区干预实验给了具体结论：'Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier'，并由此提出 'scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist'。对评测治理的直接启发：单一均分不足以判断 agent 是否在 '学习'。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）。今日动作：把五轴指标（尤其 Improvement from failure 与 Budget）抄进内部 agent 评测模板。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Visually Attributable On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: Multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable task-level supervision, yet offers limited guidance for localizing errors in visual reasoning. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) complements this supervision with dense token-level corrections from a privileged teacher equipped with an evidence-centered visual view. However, the resulting corrections may conflate visual evidence with non-visual shifts induced by linguistic priors, response style, or the privilege
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26856）：VAG 形式化了一个我认为会被更多论文引用的概念——'a token-level correction is contaminated when its update direction cannot be consistently attributed to the privileged visual evidence'（论文将其命名为 privileged-correction contamination）。成因说得清楚：'the resulting corrections may conflate visual evidence with non-visual shifts induced by linguistic priors, response style, or the privileged view itself'，直接蒸馏会 'reinforce erroneous token-level updates'。解法是把 verifier 推出的 advantage 当锚，再用一个可判定的门控——'validates each privileged correction against the contrast between evidence-present and evidence-degraded teacher views'，只放行方向上被视觉对比支持的修正。证据是 'Experiments across six visual reasoning benchmarks' 上 'consistently outperforms GRPO and OPSD methods'，并自述为 SOTA 平均分。跨域启发：证据归因污染这个框架同样适用于用强模型给弱模型做纠正的场景（RAG grounding、工具输出蒸馏），不限于视觉。代码 / benchmark / 项目页：暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）；SOTA 结论为作者自述，未见第三方复现。

papers.title: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning enables mobile robots to make fast and scalable navigation decisions in constrained human-shared environments. However, directly extending single-robot approaches to multi-robot settings often fails to ensure safety and efficiency, especially under occlusions and out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, where individual robots may overlook potential risks or make inaccurate predictions. Leveraging cooperation effectively for both prediction and navigation remains a major chall
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26852）：CoopUQ 把多机器人导航里的一个工程直觉做成了显式机制——用不确定性而不只是占用预测来驱动策略：'predicts future occupancy grid maps through cross-robot spatiotemporal feature fusion and further leverages forecasts and their uncertainty to guide policy via constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning, where the cost penalizes navigation through regions predicted to be occupied or highly uncertain'。动机是单机器人策略在遮挡与 OOD 下 'often fails to ensure safety and efficiency'，因此作者称 'This design enables the policy to adapt its risk sensitivity under distribution shifts'。证据分两层：Unity3D 仿真下的 in-distribution + OOD 对比（含不同布局、行人流密度与 rushing 行为），加真机实验 'further demonstrate its robustness across various scenes'。代码与视频今日已实测可达：项目页 https://coopuq.github.io/ （HTTP 200），仓库 https://github.com/tasl-lab/CoopUQ 。长尾理由：领域（移动机器人社会导航）与本项目相关性低，但让不确定性显式进入代价函数、而不是只进感知置信度，是可迁移的可靠性模式。

papers.title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
papers.abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8+
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26863）：Halcyon 是一次有价值的证伪型工作，问题是 'whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation'，做法是在 GPIC（100M 图文对）上从零预训练 early-fusion 多模态自回归模型族。两条带具体数字的对照：'Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8'（48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD）且预训练算力少 18.2 倍、'Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++'（35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD）且预训练算力少 275 倍；最关键的一句是 'Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation'——整个领域的默认前提被受控实验否掉。项目页今日已实测可达：https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon （HTTP 200），页面显示 Models 已提供、Code 标注 coming soon，因此代码暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）。长尾理由：与本项目直接相关性低（文生图预训练），但某类预训练并非必需这类证伪结论在未来选型时可省下大量算力。
